units.title: 痘疹亦天灾，未花而问以鬼为信：鬼空根芽未萌、鬼静气机未动、鬼散虽流行而不及、破静而痘甲不拆、破动而病或殊、鬼绝则未生花

rule.yi: 痘疹也是天降的灾，叫做天花，也叫圣疮，一出就关系到孩子的性命。还没出花就来问的，拿鬼爻作凭据：鬼空，痘的根芽还没有萌发；鬼静，气机还没有动；鬼散，痘虽在流行也轮不到他；鬼破而安静，痘的壳不裂开；鬼破而发动，得的可能是别的病；鬼绝，还没有生花。
rule.en: Pox is also a calamity from heaven, called heavenly flowers and also the sacred sore, and once it stirs it bears on a child's life. If the question is asked before the flowers have come, take the ghost as the token: if the ghost is Void, the roots and shoots of the pox have not yet sprouted; if still, the working of qi has not yet stirred; if scattered, although the pox is going about it does not reach him; if broken and still, the husk does not split; if broken and moving, the illness may be a different one; if in Extinction, the flowers have not yet been born.

zh: 夫痘疹亦天灾也，是名天花，亦名圣疮，动关童命，敢忽神筮？
yi: 痘疹也是天降的灾，叫做天花，也叫圣疮，一出就关系到孩子的性命，怎敢轻忽神明的占筮？
en: Pox is also a calamity from heaven; it is called heavenly flowers and also the sacred sore, and once it stirs it bears on a child's life; how dare one make light of the divination of the spirits?

zh: 未花而问，以鬼为信，盖鬼空根芽未萌，鬼静气机未动，鬼散虽流行而不及也。
破静而甲不拆，破动而病或殊，鬼绝则未生花也。
yi: 还没出花就来问的，拿鬼作凭据：鬼空，痘的根芽还没有萌发；鬼静，气机还没有动；鬼散，痘虽在流行也轮不到他。
鬼破而安静的，痘的壳不裂开；鬼破而发动的，得的病可能是别的；鬼绝的，还没有生花。
en: If the question is asked before the flowers have come, take the ghost as the token: if the ghost is Void, the roots and shoots have not yet sprouted; if the ghost is still, the working of qi has not yet stirred; if the ghost is scattered, although the pox is going about it does not reach him.
If broken and still, the husk does not split; if broken and moving, the illness may be a different one; if the ghost is in Extinction, the flowers have not yet been born.

zh: 以鬼为病，问痘即痘也。
月破非应有痘，鬼动是当有病，乃或癍麻疮毒，未为正痘，故曰病殊。
yi: 鬼当作病，问痘就是问痘。
月破不该有痘，鬼动是该有病，但可能是癍、麻、疮、毒，不是正经的痘，所以说病不一样。
en: The ghost is taken as the illness, and asking about pox is asking about pox.
Month-break does not mean there should be pox; a moving ghost means there should be illness, but it may be spots, measles, sores or poison, not the true pox, hence 'the illness is different'.

zh: 内详见痘、趋避、疏密、出期、何人、大象六问
yi: 下文详细讲六个问题：见痘（出不出）、趋避、疏密、出期、何人、大象。
en: The text below treats six questions in detail: whether the pox appears, avoiding it, sparse or dense, the time of coming out, who, and the great image.

note.yi: 「鬼」在这一章里就是官鬼爻，本章通篇以它为痘的凭据。「癍麻疮毒」是斑疹、麻疹、疮毒一类的病，不是「正痘」。「甲」是痘的外壳或种子的壳，「甲不拆」是壳裂不开，意思是还没出。这一条和易隐的痘疹占（LY.ILL.YY.35：鬼不上卦、鬼化死墓绝胎空、被刑害克破者皆不出）是同一个判断。
note.en: In this chapter the 'ghost' is the Pressure line throughout, and it is the token for the pox. 'Spots, measles, sores and poison' are illnesses of the spotted, measly and sore kinds and not the 'true pox'. The 'husk' (jia) is the outer shell of the pox or the husk of a seed, and 'the husk does not split' means it has not yet come out. This entry is the same judgment as the Yi Yin's on divining pox (LY.ILL.YY.35: the ghost absent from the hexagram, changing into Death, tomb, Extinction, Womb or Void, or punished, harmed, controlled or broken, means it will not come out).

units.title: 鬼动将见、鬼冲将开、鬼旺将起，当月当日则是月是日而出：官鬼值日月当见，卯鬼发动应速、卯鬼安静应迟

rule.yi: 鬼动了，痘将要出现；鬼被冲了，痘将要开；鬼旺了，痘将要起；鬼当月、当日，就在这个月、这一天出痘。官鬼当值的日、月，痘就该出现：比如丑月乙卯日，占有没有花，得到履卦变同人卦，当天就见了标；另有一人也占，得履卦变睽卦，到第二年二月才出痘，因为卯鬼发动所以应得快，卯鬼安静所以应得迟。
rule.en: When the ghost moves the pox is about to show; when the ghost is clashed it is about to open; when the ghost is strong it is about to rise; when the ghost is on duty in the month or day, it comes out in that month or on that day. The day or month on which the Pressure line is on duty, the pox should appear: for example, in a Chou month on a Yimao day, someone divined whether the flowers would come and obtained Lu changing into Tongren, and the marks showed that same day; another person also divined and obtained Lu changing into Kui, and the pox began only in the second month of the following year, because the Mao ghost moved and so it answered quickly, and the Mao ghost was still and so it answered slowly.

zh: 鬼动将见，鬼冲将开，鬼旺将起，当月当日，则是月是日而出也。
yi: 鬼动了，痘将要出现；鬼被冲了，痘将要开；鬼旺了，痘将要起；鬼当月、当日，就在这个月、这一天出痘。
en: When the ghost moves the pox is about to show; when the ghost is clashed it is about to open; when the ghost is strong it is about to rise; when the ghost is on duty in the month or day, it comes out in that month or on that day.

zh: 官鬼值日月当见，如丑建乙卯日，占有花得履之同人，当日见标，复一人亦占履之睽，及次年二月始痘，盖卯鬼发动故应速，卯鬼安静故应迟。
yi: 官鬼当值的日、月，痘就该出现：比如丑月乙卯日，占有没有花，得到履卦变同人卦，当天就见了标；另有一人也占，得履卦变睽卦，到第二年二月才出痘，因为卯鬼发动所以应得快，卯鬼安静所以应得迟。
en: The day or month on which the Pressure line is on duty, the pox should appear: for example, in a Chou month on a Yimao day, someone divined whether the flowers would come and obtained Lu changing into Tongren, and the marks showed that same day; another person also divined and obtained Lu changing into Kui, and the pox began only in the second month of the following year, because the Mao ghost moved and so it answered quickly, and the Mao ghost was still and so it answered slowly.

note.yi: 「标」是痘刚出来的点。注里两个卦例，一个当天见标、一个拖到第二年二月，解释都是同一个卯鬼——发动就快，安静就迟；这和增删卜易「鬼动逢值逢合、鬼静逢值逢冲」（LY.ILL.ZS.19）的思路相近。
note.en: A 'mark' (biao) is the spot when the pox has just come out. Of the two cases in the note, one showed marks the same day and the other was put off to the second month of the next year, and the explanation for both is the same Mao ghost — moving, it is quick, and still, it is slow; this is close in thinking to the Zengshan Buyi's 'a still ghost on the day of duty or clash, a moving ghost on the day of duty or combination' (LY.ILL.ZS.19).

units.title: 当岁而索鬼象之得失：官鬼值太岁或遇空破休囚则言未出，不可以太岁为鬼而断当年应痘；卦有两鬼一空一动取其动、一强一弱取其强，皆应当出

rule.yi: 问哪一年出痘，要探究鬼象的得失；卦里有两个鬼时，要考察其中一爻的虚实。官鬼如果值太岁，或者遇到空、破、休、囚，就说还没出，后来即使日、月会合，也不能说就有：比如己亥年辰月辛未日，占有没有痘，得同人卦，亥鬼旬空，整年平安，可见不能因为太岁就是鬼就断当年应痘。如果卦里有两个鬼，一个空一个动，就取动的；一个强一个弱，就取强的，都应当出痘；这就是所说的考察一爻的虚实。
rule.en: For the year, seek the gain or loss of the ghost's image; where there are two ghosts, examine the emptiness or fullness of one line. If the Pressure line falls on the Tai Sui, or meets Void, breaking, resting or trapped, say it has not yet come out; even if later the Day and Month meet, one cannot say there is pox: for example, in the Jihai year, the Chen month, on the Xinwei day, someone divined whether there would be pox and obtained Tongren; the Hai ghost was in Void and all year long he was well and at peace, so one cannot take the Tai Sui being the ghost as meaning the pox answers that year. If the hexagram has two ghosts, one Void and one moving, take the moving one; if one strong and one weak, take the strong one; in each case the pox should come out; this is what 'examine the emptiness or fullness of one line' means.

zh: 当岁而索鬼象之得失，有二而考一爻之虚实。
yi: 问哪一年出痘，要探究鬼象的得失；卦里有两个鬼时，要考察其中一爻的虚实。
en: For the year, seek the gain or loss of the ghost's image; where there are two, examine the emptiness or fullness of one line.

zh: 官鬼若值太岁，或遇空破休囚，则言未出，后虽日月会同，亦未可言有，如己亥年辰建辛未日，占有痘得同人，亥鬼旬空，终岁康宁，则不可以太岁为鬼而当年应痘也。
如卦有两鬼，一空一动，则以其动，一强一弱，则以其强，皆应当出，乃谓考一爻虚实尔。
yi: 官鬼如果值太岁，或者遇到空、破、休、囚，就说还没出，后来即使日、月会合，也不能说就有；比如己亥年辰月辛未日，占有没有痘，得同人卦，亥鬼旬空，整年平安，可见不能因为太岁就是鬼就断当年应痘。
如果卦里有两个鬼，一个空一个动，就取动的；一个强一个弱，就取强的，都应当出痘；这就是所说的考察一爻的虚实。
en: If the Pressure line falls on the Tai Sui, or meets Void, breaking, resting or trapped, say it has not yet come out; even if later the Day and Month meet, one cannot say there is pox: for example, in the Jihai year, the Chen month, on the Xinwei day, someone divined whether there would be pox and obtained Tongren; the Hai ghost was in Void and all year long he was well and at peace, so one cannot take the Tai Sui being the ghost as meaning the pox answers that year.

If the hexagram has two ghosts, one Void and one moving, take the moving one; if one strong and one weak, take the strong one; in each case the pox should come out; this is what 'examine the emptiness or fullness of one line' means.

units.title: 出痘由己招还是由人召、本乡还是他处：鬼在世由己招、在应由人召，在内卦本乡行灾、外卦他处流祸；往避得痘游魂鬼摇、来归不得痘归魂鬼静；伏鬼有气亦见

rule.yi: 鬼落在世爻上，是自己招来的；落在应爻上，是别人招来的；在内卦，是本乡流行的灾，在外卦，是别处流传来的祸。出去躲避反而得了痘，是游魂卦、鬼发动；回来却没得痘，是归魂卦、鬼安静；伏着的鬼有气的，痘也会出现。官鬼一动，天花就开了：在世爻是单独发出来的，在应爻是被人传染缠上的，在六爻是童仆起的根，在三爻是弟兄接着种下的；内卦是本地，外卦是外乡；游魂是出去，归魂是回来。鬼在内卦空，本地没事；鬼在外卦空，到外乡可以躲过；鬼动而卦是归魂，回家有痘；鬼空而卦是游魂，出去就能免。大体上鬼爻旺相，即使伏藏也会萌发，鬼爻休囚，即使现出来也会平息。
rule.en: On the Self the pox is called down by oneself; on the Other, called by others; in the inner trigram it is a passing calamity of the home district, in the outer trigram a spreading misfortune from elsewhere. Going away to avoid it and yet catching the pox is a Wandering Soul hexagram with the ghost moving; coming home and not catching it is a Returning Soul hexagram with the ghost still; a hidden ghost that has force also shows. When the Pressure line moves the heavenly flowers open: on the Self it is a lone outbreak, on the Other it is caught by contagion, on the sixth line the root is from a servant boy, on the third line brothers sow it in succession; the inner is the home district and the outer another place; Wandering Soul is going away and Returning Soul is coming back. If the ghost is Void in the inner trigram the home district is safe; if Void in the outer trigram one can avoid it by going elsewhere; if the ghost moves in a Returning Soul hexagram, there is pox on returning home; if the ghost is Void in a Wandering Soul hexagram, going out escapes it. In general, if the Pressure line is strong, even hidden it will sprout; if it is resting or trapped, even openly present it will subside.

zh: 世由己招，应由人召，内为本乡之行灾，外为他处之流祸。
往避而得痘，游魂鬼摇，来归而不得痘，归魂鬼静。
伏鬼有气者亦见也。
yi: 落在世爻上是自己招来的，落在应爻上是别人招来的，内卦是本乡流行的灾，外卦是别处流传来的祸。
出去躲避反而得了痘，是游魂卦、鬼发动；回来却没得痘，是归魂卦、鬼安静。
伏着的鬼有气的，痘也会出现。
en: On the Self it is called down by oneself; on the Other, called by others; in the inner trigram it is a passing calamity of the home district, in the outer trigram a spreading misfortune from elsewhere.
Going away to avoid it and yet catching the pox is a Wandering Soul hexagram with the ghost moving; coming home and not catching it is a Returning Soul hexagram with the ghost still.
A hidden ghost that has force will also show.

zh: 官鬼动，而天花开矣，在世则为特发，在应则为缠染，在六爻童仆起根，在三爻弟兄继种，内为本境，外为他乡，游魂为往，归魂为来。
盖鬼空于内，本境无事，鬼空于外，他乡可避；
鬼动归魂，回家有痘，鬼空游魂，往外得免也。
大抵鬼爻旺相，虽伏亦萌，鬼爻休囚，虽现亦息。
yi: 官鬼一动，天花就开了：在世爻是单独发出来的，在应爻是被人传染缠上的，在六爻是童仆起的根，在三爻是弟兄接着种下的；内卦是本地，外卦是外乡；游魂是出去，归魂是回来。
因为鬼在内卦空，本地没事；鬼在外卦空，到外乡可以躲过；
鬼动而卦是归魂，回家有痘；鬼空而卦是游魂，出去就能免。
大体上，鬼爻旺相的，即使伏藏也会萌发；鬼爻休囚的，即使现出来也会平息。
en: When the Pressure line moves the heavenly flowers open: on the Self it is a lone outbreak, on the Other it is caught by contagion, on the sixth line the root is from a servant boy, on the third line brothers sow it in succession; the inner is the home district and the outer another place; Wandering Soul is going away and Returning Soul is coming back.
For if the ghost is Void in the inner trigram, the home district is safe; if the ghost is Void in the outer trigram, one can avoid it by going to another place;
if the ghost moves in a Returning Soul hexagram, there is pox on returning home; if the ghost is Void in a Wandering Soul hexagram, going out escapes it.
In general, if the Pressure line is strong, even hidden it will sprout; if the Pressure line is resting or trapped, even openly present it will subside.

note.yi: 「行灾」是流行的灾，「流祸」是流传的祸，都是说痘是传染来的。「童仆起根」「弟兄继种」是注文的说法，按字面译：六爻是痘的根从童仆那里起，三爻是从弟兄那里接着传。游魂、归魂是八宫里每宫的第七、第八卦。
note.en: 'Passing calamity' and 'spreading misfortune' both say the pox comes by contagion. 'The root is from a servant boy' and 'brothers sow it in succession' are the note's wording, rendered literally: on the sixth line the root of the pox starts from a servant boy, and on the third it is passed on by brothers. Wandering Soul and Returning Soul are the seventh and eighth hexagrams of each of the eight palaces.

units.title: 占花疏密、部位、颜色：鬼旺日月生扶花稠密、空破休囚死绝痘疏朗；鬼动何宫定花丛何处（艮手臂、兑口颊、坎离上身、震巽下身）、旺在初爻先于足、六爻发于面；火鬼红紫、金鬼虚白、水鬼黑陷、木杂细、土肿大；须论用神生死定吉凶

rule.yi: 占花的稀密，问鬼的旺衰，用八卦分手足，用六爻定身形，用五行定颜色。鬼临日、月，旺相又有生扶，花一定稠密；遇到空、破、休、囚、死、绝，痘一定疏朗。鬼在哪个宫发动，花就集中在哪里；不动的，就看哪一爻旺：发在艮宫的手臂上密，动在兑宫的口和脸颊上多，坎、离在上身，震、巽在下身；旺在初爻，先出在脚上，旺在六爻，开始发在脸上，五爻在胸背，二爻在腿膝，三、四爻在腰、大腿、心口、肚子。火鬼发的，颜色红紫；金鬼动的，虚白；水鬼发的，黑而塌陷；木是杂而细，土是肿而大。但是一定要论用神的生死才能定吉凶，所以水鬼动而主象旺的，痘出现黑钉，后来仍能收功。痘症多变，假如遇到用象破空，或者某个鬼发动，就变成那种病而死，比如未月甲辰日，占孩子的痘，得到屯卦变革卦，到戊申日变成脾病而治不好。
rule.en: To divine whether the flowers are sparse or dense, ask whether the ghost is strong or weak; the eight trigrams divide hands and feet, the six lines fix the parts of the body, the five elements bring out the colours. If the ghost sits on the Day or Month, is strong and supported, the flowers are surely dense; if it meets Void, breaking, resting, trapped, death or extinction, the pox is surely sparse and clear. Wherever the ghost moves, in which palace, that fixes where the flowers cluster; if it does not move, see which line is strong: from the Gen palace, dense on the arms; moving in the Dui palace, many on the mouth and cheeks; Kan and Li the upper body, Zhen and Xun the lower; strong on the first line, first on the feet; on the sixth line, starting on the face; the fifth the chest and back, the second the legs and knees, the third and fourth the waist, thighs, heart and belly. A Fire ghost gives red-purple, a Metal ghost hollow white, a Water ghost black and sunken; Wood is mixed and fine, Earth swollen and large. But one must judge whether the Subject lives or dies before fixing fortune, so when a Water ghost moves and the main image is strong, the pox shows black nails and yet comes to completion. Pox often changes: if the image of the Subject is broken or Void, or some ghost moves, it changes into that illness and he dies — for example, in the Wei month on the Jiachen day a child's pox was divined and Zhun changing into Ge obtained, and on the Wushen day it turned into a spleen illness that could not be cured.

zh: 占花疏密，询鬼旺衰，以八卦而分手足，以六爻而定身形，以五行而著颜色，乾首坤腹，五脢二腓，金白火赤可类也。
yi: 占花的稀密，问鬼的旺衰，用八卦来分手足，用六爻来定身形，用五行来显颜色：乾是头，坤是腹，（还有）五脢、二腓，金是白、火是红，都可以类推。
en: To divine whether the flowers are sparse or dense, ask whether the ghost is strong or weak; the eight trigrams divide hands and feet, the six lines fix the parts of the body, and the five elements bring out the colours: Qian the head, Kun the belly, the back and the two calves, Metal white, Fire red, and so on by analogy.

zh: 盖鬼为痘，若临日月旺相生扶，花必绸密，如值空破休囚死绝，痘必疏朗。
凡鬼动何宫，则定花丛何处，如不动，审旺何爻，如发艮宫手臂密，如动兑宫口颊多，坎离上身，震巽下身；
旺在初爻，先有于足，旺在六爻，始发于面，五爻胸背，二爻腿膝，三四腰股心腹。
火鬼发其色红紫，金鬼动其色虚白，水鬼发其色黑陷，木为杂细，土为肿大。
然必论用神生死，而后定之吉凶，故水鬼动而主象旺者，痘见黑钉，后复收功。
然痘症多变，设遇用象破空，或值何鬼发动，则变此症而丧，如未建甲辰日，占子痘得屯之革，于戊申日乃变脾病而不治，余仿此。
yi: 因为鬼就是痘，如果临日、月旺相又有生扶，花一定稠密；如果遇到空、破、休、囚、死、绝，痘一定疏朗。
凡是鬼在哪个宫发动，就定花丛集在哪里，如果不动，就审哪一爻旺：发在艮宫的手臂上密，动在兑宫的口和脸颊上多，坎、离在上身，震、巽在下身；
旺在初爻，先出在脚上；旺在六爻，开始发在脸上；五爻在胸背，二爻在腿膝，三、四爻在腰、大腿、心口、肚子。
火鬼发的，颜色红紫；金鬼动的，颜色虚白；水鬼发的，颜色黑而塌陷；木是杂而细，土是肿而大。
但是一定要论用神的生死，然后才能定吉凶，所以水鬼动而主象旺的，痘出现黑钉，后来仍能收功。
痘症多变，假如遇到用象破空，或者某个鬼发动，就变成那种病而死；比如未月甲辰日，占孩子的痘，得到屯卦变革卦，到戊申日变成脾病而治不好，其余照此。
en: For the ghost is the pox: if it sits on the Day or Month, is strong and is supported, the flowers are surely dense; if it meets Void, breaking, resting, trapped, death or extinction, the pox is surely sparse and clear.

Wherever the ghost moves, in which palace, that fixes where the flowers cluster; if it does not move, see which line is strong: from the Gen palace, dense on the arms; moving in the Dui palace, many on the mouth and cheeks; Kan and Li the upper body, Zhen and Xun the lower body;

strong on the first line, first on the feet; strong on the sixth line, starting on the face; the fifth line the chest and back, the second the legs and knees, the third and fourth the waist, thighs, heart and belly.
A Fire ghost moving gives a red-purple colour, a Metal ghost a hollow white, a Water ghost a black, sunken colour; Wood is mixed and fine, Earth swollen and large.

But one must judge whether the Subject is alive or dying before fixing fortune, so when a Water ghost moves and the main image is strong, the pox shows black nails, yet afterwards comes to completion.

But pox often changes; if the image of the Subject is broken or Void, or some ghost moves, it changes into that illness and he dies: for example, in the Wei month on the Jiachen day a child's pox was divined and Zhun changing into Ge obtained, and on the Wushen day it turned into a spleen illness that could not be cured; the rest follow this.

dispute.yi: 痘长在哪里、颜色如何：易冒这里按鬼所在的宫（艮手臂、兑口颊、坎离上身、震巽下身）和鬼旺在哪一爻（初爻足、六爻面）来断，增删卜易也是这样（乾多生头、坤多腹、艮多手、兑多口、坎离上身、震巽下身，LY.ILL.ZS.20），两家一致，颜色也相同（火鬼紫红、金鬼虚白、水鬼黑陷、木杂细、土肿大）。卜筮正宗讲的是好了以后留下的毛病在哪里（LY.ILL.BSZZ.23–25），兑宫一说口、一说面，与这里说的口颊又有出入。
dispute.en: Where the pox grows and what colour: the Yi Mao judges here by the palace the ghost stands in (Gen the arms, Dui the mouth and cheeks, Kan and Li the upper body, Zhen and Xun the lower) and by which line the ghost is strong on (first line the feet, sixth line the face), and so does the Zengshan Buyi (Qian mostly on the head, Kun on the belly, Gen on the hands, Dui on the mouth, Kan and Li on the upper body, Zhen and Xun on the lower, LY.ILL.ZS.20); the two agree, and the colours are the same too (Fire ghost purple-red, Metal hollow white, Water black and sunken, Wood mixed and fine, Earth swollen and large). The Bushi Zhengzong speaks of where the ailment left after recovery lies (LY.ILL.BSZZ.23-25), and gives the Dui palace once as the mouth and once as the face, which again differs slightly from the mouth and cheeks here.

note.yi: 「五脢」是脊柱两旁的肉，「二腓」是两个小腿肚。「黑钉」是黑色的痘，一种险象。注的最后一个例（屯之革，戊申日变脾病）是说痘症会变成别的病而致命。这一条和易隐 LY.ILL.YY.35「鬼衰子旺则稀朗、鬼旺子衰则稠密」和卜筮正宗 LY.ILL.BSZZ.06「福旺则花必稀疏」方向一致。
note.en: 'The back' (wumei) is the flesh on either side of the spine and 'the two calves' (erfei) the two calf muscles. 'Black nails' are black pox, a dangerous sign. The last example in the note (Zhun into Ge, turning into a spleen illness on the Wushen day) says that pox may change into another illness and prove fatal. This entry is in the same direction as the Yi Yin's LY.ILL.YY.35 ('ghost weak and Output strong, sparse; ghost strong and Output weak, dense') and the Bushi Zhengzong's LY.ILL.BSZZ.06 ('Output strong and the flowers are sparse').

units.title: 问痘见何人：鬼当本命、鬼化卦宫者应之；考六亲化鬼及鬼化六亲，必鬼旺动；官鬼值何人本命则是人有痘，鬼动艮宫少男、化离象中女、财爻化鬼奴仆、鬼化子孩提

rule.yi: 如果问是谁出痘，鬼爻正当他的本命的，或者鬼变成（某人所属的）卦宫的，就应在这个人身上。考察哪个六亲变出鬼、鬼变成哪个六亲，就知道出痘的是这个人；但也必须鬼旺又动才会发。一家之内，官鬼正当哪个人的本命，就说这个人有痘；又，鬼动在艮宫，是少男；鬼变成离象，是中女；财爻变鬼，是奴仆；鬼变成子孙，是幼儿；总之要在鬼爻旺又动的前提下才这样说。
rule.en: If asked who will have the pox, it answers on the one whose natal branch the ghost stands on, or on the person whose palace the ghost changes into. Examine which relation changes into the ghost and which relation the ghost changes into, and that is the person who has the pox; but the ghost must also be strong and moving before it breaks out. Within one household, whoever's natal branch the Pressure line stands on, say that person has the pox; again, a ghost moving in the Gen palace is the youngest son; a ghost changing into the Li image, the middle daughter; a Wealth line changing into a ghost, a servant; a ghost changing into Output, an infant; in general one says so only where the Pressure line is strong and moving.

zh: 如问痘见何人，鬼当本命，鬼化卦宫者应之。
考六亲之化鬼，及鬼化之六亲，则痘是人也，然亦必鬼旺动而发焉。
yi: 如果问是谁出痘，鬼正当他的本命的，或者鬼变成（某人所属的）卦宫的，就应在这个人身上。
考察哪个六亲变出鬼、鬼变成哪个六亲，就知道出痘的是这个人；但也必须鬼旺又动才会发。
en: If asked who will have the pox, it answers on the one whose natal branch the ghost stands on, or on the person whose palace the ghost changes into.
Examine which relation changes into the ghost and which relation the ghost changes into, and that is the person who has the pox; but the ghost must also be strong and moving before it breaks out.

zh: 一家之内，以官鬼值何人本命，则曰是人有痘。
又鬼动艮宫，则曰少男，鬼化离象，则曰中女，财爻化鬼，则曰奴仆，鬼象化子，则曰孩提，大抵务于鬼爻旺动而言也。
yi: 一家之内，官鬼正当哪个人的本命，就说这个人有痘。
又，鬼动在艮宫，就说是少男；鬼变成离象，就说是中女；财爻变鬼，就说是奴仆；鬼变成子孙，就说是幼儿；总之要在鬼爻旺又动的前提下才这样说。
en: Within one household, whoever's natal branch the Pressure line stands on, say that person has the pox.

Again, if the ghost moves in the Gen palace, say the youngest son; if the ghost changes into the Li image, the middle daughter; if the Wealth line changes into a ghost, a servant; if the ghost image changes into Output, an infant; in general one says so only where the Pressure line is strong and moving.

note.yi: 「本命」是人生年的地支。易冒疾病章后面还有一条同样的说法，「占父病而鬼动于坤，其母随之而疾」（LY.ILL.YM.33），那里也是用鬼动在哪个宫来推还有谁会病。
note.en: The 'natal branch' is the earthly branch of a person's birth year. Later in the chapter on illness the Yi Mao has a similar saying, 'divining a father's illness with the ghost moving in Kun, his mother follows with the illness' (LY.ILL.YM.33), which likewise uses the palace in which the ghost moves to work out who else will fall ill.

units.title: 问孩童何时见痘：官鬼当值及生旺官鬼的年月日；上下鬼填其虚、变伏鬼实其质；问岁以年计、问时以月计；两鬼一空一实以填补空鬼为期，卦无官而伏变爻有者以变伏之鬼所值为期

rule.yi: 如果问孩子什么时候出痘，是官鬼当值的年、月、日，以及生旺官鬼的年、月、日；上下的鬼填补它的空，变出的鬼、伏着的鬼落实它的实体。远近要分开占：问哪一岁就以年计，问什么时候就以月计，先看填实的时间，再看生旺的年月来断；如果卦里有两个鬼，一个空一个实，反而以填补空鬼的时间为期；卦里一个官也没有，而伏爻、变爻上有的，就以变出、伏着的鬼所值的时间为期。
rule.en: If asked when a child will have the pox, it is the year, month or day on which the Pressure line is on duty, and the year, month or day that strengthens the Pressure line; the ghosts above and below fill its emptiness, and the changed or hidden ghost makes its substance real. Far and near are divined separately: asking which year, count by years; asking when, count by months; first the time of filling the emptiness, then the years and months of strength; if the hexagram has two ghosts, one Void and one full, the time of filling the Void ghost is taken as the term instead; if the hexagram has no Pressure line at all but the hidden or changed lines have one, take the time held by the changed or hidden ghost as the term.

zh: 如问孩童何时见痘，当官鬼之年月日，及生旺官鬼之年月日则痘也。
上下鬼而填其虚，变伏鬼而实其质。
yi: 如果问孩子什么时候出痘，是官鬼当值的年、月、日，以及生旺官鬼的年、月、日，就出痘。
上下的鬼用来填补它的空，变出的鬼、伏着的鬼用来落实它的实体。
en: If asked when a child will have the pox, it is the year, month or day on which the Pressure line is on duty, and the year, month or day that strengthens the Pressure line.
The ghosts above and below fill its emptiness, and the changed or hidden ghost makes its substance real.

zh: 远近分卜，问何岁则以年计，问何时则以月计，先以填实，次以生旺年月断之。
若卦有两鬼，或一空一实，反以填补空鬼为期；
卦无一官，或伏爻变爻有者，当以变伏之鬼所值为期也。
yi: 远近要分开占：问哪一岁就以年来计，问什么时候就以月来计，先看填实的时间，再看生旺的年月来断。
如果卦里有两个鬼，一个空一个实，反而以填补空鬼的时间为期；
卦里一个官爻也没有，而伏爻、变爻上有的，就以变出、伏着的鬼所值的时间为期。
en: Far and near are divined separately: asking which year, count by years; asking when, count by months; first the time of filling the emptiness, then the years and months of strength.
If the hexagram has two ghosts, one Void and one full, the time of filling the Void ghost is taken as the term instead;
if the hexagram has no Pressure line at all but the hidden or changed lines have one, take the time held by the changed or hidden ghost as the term.

note.yi: 「填实」是空的爻等到它的地支值年、值月、值日，把空补上；「上下鬼」按注是卦里上、下两个鬼。这一条和增删卜易讲的出花之期（LY.ILL.ZS.19：鬼静逢值逢冲、鬼动逢值逢合、鬼空破在填实之时、鬼伏在出现之岁）是同一路，只是易冒多了两个鬼、无鬼时怎么取。
note.en: 'Filling' is a Void line waiting for the year, month or day of its own branch to fill it; the 'ghosts above and below' are, by the note, the two ghosts in the hexagram. This entry is on the same road as the Zengshan Buyi's time for the flowers to come out (LY.ILL.ZS.19: a still ghost on the day of duty or clash, a moving ghost on duty or combination, a Void or broken ghost at the time of filling, a hidden ghost in the year it appears); the Yi Mao adds only what to do with two ghosts and with none.

units.title: 既痘而筮大象：七日之内三冲是戒（花未开先谢）；卦属反伏墓绝与命随鬼墓虽用旺难治，四忌之外再考用神；鬼旺用旺花丛根固吉、鬼坏用坏花悴根枯凶；生旺用神之日有成、冲鬼象之辰有变；感不感在鬼、害不害在用，鬼化鬼痘后痍、交加动瘄痘相参

rule.yi: 已经出痘，再占整体的吉凶：七天之内，要戒备三冲，就是花还没开就先谢了。卦是反吟、伏吟、入墓、入绝的，和本命随鬼入墓的，即使用爻旺也难治；这四种忌讳之外，再考察用神。鬼旺而用爻旺，花丛茂盛、根牢固，是吉；鬼坏而用爻坏，花憔悴、根枯，是凶。生旺用神的日子是有成的时候，冲鬼象的时辰是有变的日期。大体上，感染不感染取决于鬼，有害没害取决于用爻；鬼变鬼的，痘后有疮痍；交错发动的，是瘄和痘掺杂。注说：这是专就用爻来说吉凶，不再论鬼的衰旺；如果用爻有生扶救助，鬼旺不过是花密；鬼爻被填实、被冲动，不过是要防变；鬼变鬼和用爻变鬼，不过是痘后余毒；鬼交错发动，或者有别的病夹杂，也没到大害的地步。
rule.en: Once the pox has come and one divines the great image's fortune, within seven days the three clashes are the thing to guard against, meaning the flower withers before it has opened. A hexagram that is Reversed, Hidden, in a tomb or in Extinction, and one where the natal branch follows the ghost into a tomb, are hard to treat even if the Subject line is strong; apart from these four taboos, then examine the Subject. If the ghost is strong and the Subject line strong, the flowers are luxuriant and the roots firm, which is auspicious; if the ghost is spoiled and the Subject line spoiled, the flowers droop and the roots wither, which is ominous. The day that strengthens the Subject is the time of completion, the hour that clashes the ghost image the time of change. In general whether the child catches it depends on the ghost, whether it does harm on the Subject line; a ghost changing into a ghost means sores after the pox; lines moving in tangles mean measles and pox mixed together. The note says: this speaks of fortune purely by the Subject line and no longer discusses whether the ghost is strong or weak; if the Subject line has generation, support and rescue, a strong ghost only means dense flowers; if the Pressure line is filled or stirred by a clash, it only means guarding against change; a ghost changing into a ghost, or the Subject line changing into a ghost, only means residual poison after the pox; ghosts moving in tangles, or another illness riding along, does not amount to great harm.

zh: 既痘而筮大象之吉凶，七日之内，三冲是戒，谓花未开而先谢也。
卦属反伏墓绝，与命随鬼墓，虽用旺难治，四忌之外，再考用神。
盖鬼旺而用旺花丛而根固，乃吉，鬼坏而用坏，花悴而根枯，乃凶。
生旺用神之日，为有成时，当冲鬼象之辰，为有变期也。
大抵感不感务乎鬼，害不害务乎用，鬼化鬼者痘后痍，交加动者，瘄痘相参也。
yi: 已经出痘，再占整体的吉凶：七天之内，要戒备三冲，就是花还没开就先谢了。
卦是反吟、伏吟、入墓、入绝的，和本命随鬼入墓的，即使用爻旺也难治；这四种忌讳之外，再考察用神。
鬼旺而用爻旺，花丛茂盛、根牢固，是吉；鬼坏而用爻坏，花憔悴、根枯，是凶。
生旺用神的日子，是有成的时候；冲鬼象的时辰，是有变的日期。
大体上，感染不感染取决于鬼，有害没害取决于用爻；鬼变鬼的，痘后有疮痍；交错发动的，是瘄和痘掺杂。
en: Once the pox has come and one divines the great image's fortune, within seven days the three clashes are the thing to guard against, meaning the flower withers before it has opened.

A hexagram that is Reversed, Hidden, in a tomb or in Extinction, and one where the natal branch follows the ghost into a tomb, are hard to treat even if the Subject line is strong; apart from these four taboos, then examine the Subject.

If the ghost is strong and the Subject line strong, the flowers are luxuriant and the roots firm, which is auspicious; if the ghost is spoiled and the Subject line spoiled, the flowers droop and the roots wither, which is ominous.
The day that strengthens the Subject is the time of completion; the hour that clashes the ghost image is the time of change.

In general whether the child catches it depends on the ghost, whether it does harm on the Subject line; a ghost changing into a ghost means sores after the pox; lines moving in tangles mean measles and pox mixed together.

zh: 此专务用爻而言吉凶，不复论鬼衰旺。
若用爻有生扶救助，鬼旺无非花密，鬼爻填实冲动，无非防变，鬼化鬼及用化鬼，无非痘后余毒，交加鬼发，或别病相乘而已，未至大害也。
yi: 这是专就用爻来说吉凶，不再论鬼的衰旺。
如果用爻有生扶救助，鬼旺不过是花密；鬼爻被填实、被冲动，不过是要防变；鬼变鬼和用爻变鬼，不过是痘后余毒；鬼交错发动，或者有别的病夹杂，也没到大害的地步。
en: This speaks of fortune purely by the Subject line and no longer discusses whether the ghost is strong or weak.

If the Subject line has generation, support and rescue, a strong ghost only means dense flowers; if the Pressure line is filled or stirred by a clash, it only means guarding against change; a ghost changing into a ghost, or the Subject line changing into a ghost, only means residual poison after the pox; ghosts moving in tangles, or another illness riding along, does not amount to great harm.

note.yi: 「四忌」是卦反（反吟）、卦伏（伏吟）、卦墓、卦绝，再加「命随鬼墓」这一项，书里合称「反伏墓绝与命随鬼墓」；「三冲」按易冒的用法是卦冲的三种情形。「瘄」是麻疹。注文里「痘后痍」「痘后余毒」都是痘好了以后留下的疮疡和余毒。这一条把吉凶全归到用爻（用神），与增删卜易讲痘的吉凶全在子孙爻（LY.ILL.ZS.21）相近，只是易冒的用神是所占那个人的爻，不专指子孙。
note.en: The 'four taboos' are the hexagram Reversed (Reversed Chant), Hidden (Hidden Chant), in a tomb and in Extinction, and the book adds 'the natal branch following the ghost into a tomb', naming them together as 'Reversed, Hidden, tomb, Extinction, and the natal branch following the ghost into a tomb'; the 'three clashes' in the Yi Mao's usage are the three cases of a hexagram in clash. 'Cu' is measles. 'Sores after the pox' and 'residual poison after the pox' are the sores and leftover poison after the pox has healed. This entry puts fortune wholly in the Subject line, close to the Zengshan Buyi's putting the fortune of pox wholly in the Output line (LY.ILL.ZS.21), except that the Yi Mao's Subject is the line of the person divined and not specifically Output.

units.title: 既疾必筮其吉凶而调剂之：慎于未病是君子之道；命随鬼墓是不治之疾（例：卦中子孙旺相病不死，亥命随官入墓，半年内溺水亡）

rule.yi: 生死有命，不是祈祷能改的；疾病在于人，不可以忽视；没生病之前就谨慎，是君子的做法。已经生了病，能不占问它的吉凶而加以调理吗？本命跟着鬼入了墓，是治不好的病。比如戌月甲辰日，占儿子的病，他生于己亥年，得同人卦，卦中子孙旺相、六爻安静，病应当不会死，但是亥命随官入了墓，按法大凶；后来他的病没有死，却不到半年溺水而死。
rule.en: Life and death have their appointed lot and cannot be prayed away; illness lies with the person and must not be neglected; to take care before falling ill is the way of the gentleman. Once ill, can one fail to divine its fortune and adjust the treatment? If the natal branch follows the ghost into a tomb, it is an untreatable illness. For example, in the Xu month on the Jiachen day, someone divined a son's illness; he was born in a Jihai year and the hexagram was Tongren, with Output strong and the six lines still, so the illness should not kill; but the Hai natal branch followed Pressure into a tomb, which by the method is a great ill omen; afterwards he did not die of the illness, but within half a year he drowned.

zh: 夫死生有命，不可祷也，疾病在人，不可忽也，慎于未病，君子之道也。
既疾，可不筮其吉凶而调剂之？
命随鬼墓，不治之疾也。
yi: 生死有命，不是祈祷能改的；疾病在于人，不可以忽视；没生病之前就谨慎，是君子的做法。
已经生了病，能不占问它的吉凶而加以调理吗？
本命跟着鬼入了墓，是治不好的病。
en: Life and death have their appointed lot and cannot be prayed away; illness lies with the person and must not be neglected; to take care before falling ill is the way of the gentleman.
Once ill, can one fail to divine its fortune and adjust the treatment?
If the natal branch follows the ghost into a tomb, it is an untreatable illness.

zh: 如戌建甲辰日占子病，生年己亥，得同人，卦中子孙旺相，六爻安静，病应不死，然亥命随官入墓，法主大凶。
后其疾不死，未半年溺水而亡。
yi: 比如戌月甲辰日，占儿子的病，他生于己亥年，得同人卦，卦中子孙旺相、六爻安静，病应当不会死，但是亥命随官入了墓，按法大凶。
后来他的病没有死，却不到半年溺水而死。
en: For example, in the Xu month on the Jiachen day, someone divined a son's illness; he was born in a Jihai year and the hexagram was Tongren, with Output strong and the six lines still, so the illness should not kill; but the Hai natal branch followed Pressure into a tomb, which by the method is a great ill omen.
Afterwards he did not die of the illness, but within half a year he drowned.

zh: 内详症候、防疫、真假、成疾、养病、避暑六问
yi: 下文详细讲六个问题：症候、防疫、真假、成疾、养病、避暑。
en: The text below treats six questions in detail: symptoms, guarding against epidemic, real or false, becoming a chronic ailment, convalescence, and summer retreat.

note.yi: 「命随鬼墓」的「命」是本命（出生年的地支），「随鬼入墓」是本命的地支跟着官鬼入墓。这一条例子里病人没有死于病却死于水，说明这个象断的是「命」不是「病」——和黄金策讲的「命入幽明两墓」（LY.ILL.HJC.54）、「世上临鬼不可随官入墓」（LY.ILL.HJC.41）、易隐的「用爻随鬼入墓者死」（LY.ILL.YY.05）是同一个象。
note.en: The 'destiny' of 'the destiny following the ghost into a tomb' is the natal branch (the branch of the birth year), and 'following the ghost into a tomb' is the natal branch entering a tomb along with the Pressure line. In the example the patient did not die of the illness but of water, which shows that this image judges the 'destiny' and not the 'illness' — it is the same image as the Huangjin Ce's 'the destiny entering the bright and dark tombs' (LY.ILL.HJC.54) and 'the Self holding Pressure must not follow Pressure into a tomb' (LY.ILL.HJC.41) and the Yi Yin's 'if the Subject line follows the ghost into a tomb, he dies' (LY.ILL.YY.05).

units.title: 卦属反伏墓绝亦不治；病未久三冲而愈、病已久三冲而亡，此三者不论用神衰旺；外此专重用神——动散、月破、克空、日破、受伤无援、脱气者危，日月动变有一能救则危而复安

rule.yi: 卦是反吟、伏吟、入墓、入绝的，也治不好，即使能治好也会落下病根。病没多久的，遇到三冲就好；病已经久了的，遇到三冲就死；这三种情形不论用神的衰旺。除此之外，就专门看重用神：遇到动散、月破、克空、日破、受伤没有救援、脱气的，危险；遇到日、月、动爻、变爻里有一个能救的，危险了又能转安。注里给了每一种的例子（七种情形都是大凶，得到日、月、动爻、变爻里有一个能救的，就要反过来看）。
rule.en: A hexagram that is Reversed, Hidden, in a tomb or in Extinction is likewise untreatable, and even if it can be treated, it becomes a lingering ailment. If the illness is not old, the three clashes cure it; if it is already long, the three clashes bring death; in these three cases the strength or weakness of the Subject is not considered. Apart from this, the Subject is what matters above all: if it meets moving-and-scattering, Month-break, control-into-Void, Day-break, being wounded without help, or drained of qi, it is in danger; if any one of the Day, Month, moving or changed lines can rescue it, danger turns again to safety. The note gives an example of each (the seven cases are all great ill omens, but if any one of the Day, Month, moving or changed lines can rescue, then look at it the other way round).

zh: 卦属反伏墓绝，亦不治也，即能治亦成疾矣。
病未久者，三冲而愈，病已久者，三冲而亡，此三者不论用神衰旺也。
外此，则专重用神矣，如遇动散、月破、克空、日破、受伤无援、脱气者危，遇日月动变有一能救者，危而复安。
yi: 卦是反吟、伏吟、入墓、入绝的，也是治不好的，即使能治好，也会落下病根（成了老病）。
病没多久的，遇到三冲就好；病已经久了的，遇到三冲就死；这三种情形不论用神的衰旺。
除此之外，就专门看重用神了：如果遇到动散、月破、克空、日破、受伤没有救援、脱气的，危险；遇到日、月、动爻、变爻里有一个能救的，危险了又能转安。
en: A hexagram that is Reversed, Hidden, in a tomb or in Extinction is likewise untreatable, and even if it can be treated, it becomes a lingering ailment.
If the illness is not old, the three clashes cure it; if it is already long, the three clashes bring death; in these three cases the strength or weakness of the Subject is not considered.

Apart from this, the Subject is what matters above all: if it meets moving-and-scattering, Month-break, control-into-Void, Day-break, being wounded without help, or drained of qi, it is in danger; if any one of the Day, Month, moving lines or changed lines can rescue it, danger turns again to safety.

zh: 动散，如卯建丙寅日，占子病得渐之观是也；
月破，如癸卯岁卯建壬子日，占予妻病得离，遂亡本月是也；
克空，如酉建丁未日，占父病得未济是也；
日破，如戌建辛酉日，占夫病得渐是也；
受伤无援，如子建戊子日，占弟兄得鼎之旅，一占弟兄得离，皆为受伤无援；
脱气，如戌建戊辰日，占己病得萃之讼，乃为脱气。
以上七法系大凶，得日月动变有一能救者，则反观之。
yi: 动散，比如卯月丙寅日，占儿子的病，得到渐卦变观卦，就是；
月破，比如癸卯年卯月壬子日，占我妻子的病，得到离卦，当月就死了，就是；
克空，比如酉月丁未日，占父亲的病，得到未济卦，就是；
日破，比如戌月辛酉日，占丈夫的病，得到渐卦，就是；
受伤无援，比如子月戊子日，占兄弟得鼎卦变旅卦，又一次占兄弟得离卦，都是受伤没有救援；
脱气，比如戌月戊辰日，占自己的病，得到萃卦变讼卦，就是脱气。
以上七种情形都是大凶，但得到日、月、动爻、变爻里有一个能救的，就要反过来看。
en: 'Moving and scattering' is, for example, in the Mao month on the Bingyin day, a son's illness divined and Jian (Gradual) changing into Guan obtained;
'Month-break' is, for example, in the Guimao year, the Mao month, on the Renzi day, my wife's illness divined and Li obtained, and she died within that month;
'Control-into-Void' is, for example, in the You month on the Dingwei day, a father's illness divined and Weiji obtained;
'Day-break' is, for example, in the Xu month on the Xinyou day, a husband's illness divined and Jian (Gradual) obtained;

'Wounded without help' is, for example, in the Zi month on the Wuzi day, a brother's illness divined and Ding changing into Lü obtained, and another divination of a brother's obtained Li, both wounded without help;
'Drained of qi' is, for example, in the Xu month on the Wuchen day, one's own illness divined and Cui changing into Song obtained, which is drained of qi.
The above seven are all great ill omens, but if any one of the Day, Month, moving lines or changed lines can rescue, then look at it the other way round.

note.yi: 原文说「以上七法」，但列出的只有动散、月破、克空、日破、受伤无援、脱气六项名目；把「受伤」「无援」算两件，就是七种，书里没有说明。「动散」是动爻发动而被冲散；「克空」是被克又落空。三冲与久病新病的分法，易隐讲近病逢六冲则愈、久病逢冲则死的地方见 LY.ILL.YY.07，黄金策与增删卜易见 LY.ILL.ZS.02、LY.ILL.ZS.03。
note.en: The original says 'the above seven methods' but lists only six names — moving-and-scattering, Month-break, control-into-Void, Day-break, wounded-without-help and drained-of-qi; counting 'wounded' and 'without help' as two makes seven, which the book does not explain. 'Moving and scattering' is a moving line that is clashed apart; 'control into Void' is a line controlled and also Void. For the division of recent and long illness under the three clashes, where the Yi Yin says a recent illness is cured by a Six-Clash and a long illness dies, see LY.ILL.YY.07, and for the Huangjin Ce and Zengshan Buyi see LY.ILL.ZS.02 and LY.ILL.ZS.03.

units.title: 考之占验：四灭没、十卦、无鬼无财、身空命空、凶煞皆不死，死者必用神死则死、用神生则生（神煞尤轻）

rule.yi: 从占验来看，四灭、四没的卦不死，十卦不死，没有鬼、没有财的不死，身空、命空的不死，遇到凶煞的不死；那么人之所以死，一定是用神死了他就死，用神生旺他就活。灭没：春天需、蒙，夏天观、蛊，秋天剥、节，冬天旅、临。十卦：明夷、观、贲、大畜、丰、同人、蛊、夬、需、临。凶煞：三坵五墓、丧车这一类。比如占父亲的病，六月得观卦，凭什么会死？用爻当日、月，卦里没有财、鬼，有什么凶？因为用爻坏而没有鬼，即使祈祷也得不到保佑；用爻旺而没有鬼，不祈祷也安康；没有财而用爻绝，天禄已尽；没有财而用爻旺，只是吃得少。甲子旬空亥，难道亥年生的人就不能问病？寅月破申，难道申年生的人就不能占病？所以应爻（空）不必作戒；身空的，有世爻、卦身可以凭据；本命不出现的，有变卦、伏爻可以取用。大体上专心看用爻来定生死安危，才真正得到《易》的宗旨，神煞就更轻了。
rule.en: Examining what divinations have proved: with the Four Extinguishing and Submerging hexagrams he does not die; with the ten hexagrams he does not die; with no ghost and no Wealth he does not die; with the Body Void or the destiny Void he does not die; with malign stars he does not die; so what he dies of must be that he dies when the Subject dies and lives when the Subject lives. The Extinguishing and Submerging: in spring Xu and Meng, in summer Guan and Gu, in autumn Bo and Jie, in winter Lü and Lin. The ten hexagrams: Mingyi, Guan, Bi (Adornment), Daxu, Feng, Tongren, Gu, Guai, Xu and Lin. Malign stars are such as Three Mounds and Five Tombs and the Funeral Carriage. For example, in divining a father's illness, if in the sixth month one obtains Guan, from what would he die? The Subject line sits on the Day and Month and the hexagram has neither Wealth nor ghost: what ill omen is there? For if the Subject line is spoiled and there is no ghost, prayer brings no protection; if strong and no ghost, he is well without praying; with no Wealth and the Subject in Extinction the heavenly emolument has ended; with no Wealth and the Subject strong he merely takes little food. If the Jiazi decade leaves Hai Void, may a person of the Hai natal branch not ask about illness? If the Yin month is a Month-break against Shen, may a person of the Shen natal branch not divine illness? So the Other line need not be a warning; if the Body is Void, the Self and Body can be relied on; if the natal branch does not appear, the changed hexagram and hidden lines can be taken. In general, to concentrate on the Subject line to fix life and death, safety and danger, truly grasps the intent of the Yi; the spirit-stars weigh lighter still.

zh: 考之占验，四灭没不死，十卦不死，无鬼无财不死，身空命空不死，凶煞不死，则其所以死者，必用神死则死，用神生则生尔。
yi: 从占验来看，四灭、四没的卦不死，十卦不死，没有鬼、没有财的不死，身空、命空的不死，遇到凶煞的不死；那么人之所以死，一定是用神死了他就死，用神生旺他就活。
en: Examining what divinations have proved: with the Four Extinguishing and Submerging hexagrams he does not die; with the ten hexagrams he does not die; with no ghost and no Wealth he does not die; with the Body Void or the destiny Void he does not die; with malign stars he does not die; so what he dies of must be that he dies when the Subject dies and lives when the Subject lives.

zh: 灭没，春需蒙，夏观蛊，秋剥节，冬旅临是也。
十卦，明夷观贲大畜丰同人蛊夬需临是也。
凶煞，三坵五墓丧车之类。
如占父病，六月得观，何从而死？
用居日月，卦无财鬼，何凶？
盖用坏无鬼，虽祷不祐，用旺无鬼，不祈亦康，无财用绝，天禄已终，无财用旺，饮食少进尔。
甲子旬空亥，则亥命不可问病，寅月破申，则申命不可占疾乎。
故应不为戒，身空，有世爻卦身可凭，本命不现，有变卦伏爻可取。
大抵专务用爻，以定生死安危，诚得易旨也。
神煞尤轻。
yi: 灭没：春天需、蒙，夏天观、蛊，秋天剥、节，冬天旅、临。
十卦：明夷、观、贲、大畜、丰、同人、蛊、夬、需、临。
凶煞：三坵五墓、丧车这一类。
比如占父亲的病，六月得观卦，凭什么会死？
用爻当日、月，卦里没有财、鬼，有什么凶？
因为用爻坏而没有鬼，即使祈祷也得不到保佑；用爻旺而没有鬼，不祈祷也安康；没有财而用爻绝，天禄已尽；没有财而用爻旺，只是吃得少。
甲子旬空亥，难道亥年生的人就不能问病？寅月破申，难道申年生的人就不能占病？
所以应爻（空）不必作戒；身空的，有世爻、卦身可以凭据；本命不出现的，有变卦、伏爻可以取用。
大体上专心看用爻来定生死安危，才真正得到《易》的宗旨。
神煞就更轻了。
en: The Extinguishing and Submerging: in spring Xu and Meng, in summer Guan and Gu, in autumn Bo and Jie, in winter Lü and Lin.
The ten hexagrams: Mingyi, Guan, Bi (Adornment), Daxu, Feng, Tongren, Gu, Guai, Xu and Lin.
Malign stars are such as Three Mounds and Five Tombs and the Funeral Carriage.
For example, in divining a father's illness, if in the sixth month one obtains Guan, from what would he die?
The Subject line sits on the Day and Month and the hexagram has neither Wealth nor ghost: what ill omen is there?

For if the Subject line is spoiled and there is no ghost, prayer brings no protection; if the Subject line is strong and there is no ghost, he is well without praying; with no Wealth and the Subject in Extinction, the heavenly emolument has ended; with no Wealth and the Subject strong, he merely takes little food.

If the Jiazi decade leaves Hai Void, may a person of the Hai natal branch not ask about illness? If the Yin month is a Month-break against Shen, may a person of the Shen natal branch not divine illness?
So the Other line need not be a warning; if the Body is Void, the Self line and the Body can be relied on; if the natal branch does not appear, the changed hexagram and hidden lines can be taken.
In general, to concentrate on the Subject line to fix life and death, safety and danger, truly grasps the intent of the Yi.
The spirit-stars weigh lighter still.

dispute.yi: 凶卦、凶煞碰上了，死不死：易冒说四灭没、十卦、凶煞（三坵五墓丧车）都不死，死不死只看用神生死，神煞尤轻；易隐则把黄泉杀、四灭卦、四没卦、棺椁杀列为占病逢之必死的卦，又把三坵五墓、丧门吊客、死符丧车等列为动而临用必死的凶煞（LY.ILL.YY.05、LY.ILL.YY.08）。同一批卦名和凶煞，两本书的结论相反；增删卜易的野鹤同样说卦名、卦身、蛇虎星煞都不验、只看用神（LY.ILL.ZS.01），与易冒一边。
dispute.en: Whether meeting the ill-omened hexagrams and stars means death: the Yi Mao says that the Four Extinguishing and Submerging hexagrams, the ten hexagrams and the malign stars (Three Mounds and Five Tombs, the Funeral Carriage) do not mean death, that death rests only on whether the Subject lives or dies, and that the spirit-stars weigh lighter still; the Yi Yin, on the other hand, lists the Yellow Springs, the Four Extinguishing, the Four Submerging and the Coffin killers as hexagrams that mean death for one who divines illness, and lists Three Mounds and Five Tombs, Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence, Death Tally and Funeral Carriage and the like as malign stars that mean death when they move and sit on or control the Subject (LY.ILL.YY.05 and LY.ILL.YY.08). The same hexagram names and stars, and the two books' conclusions are opposite; the Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi likewise says hexagram names, the Body and the Snake, Tiger and other stars are not reliable and only the Subject counts (LY.ILL.ZS.01), and stands with the Yi Mao.

note.yi: 这一条的口气是「我们试过、检验过」：开头是「考之占验」，是作者拿实际占验的结果来反驳一批流行的凶象。「灭没」的名单和易隐的四灭卦、四没卦（LY.ILL.YY.08）是同一批，易冒把它们合称「灭没」，两本书对季节的配法一致。「天禄」在这里是财。「甲子旬空亥」是甲子旬里空的是戌亥，亥命被旬空。
note.en: The tone here is 'we have tried and tested it': it opens 'examining what divinations have proved', with the author using actual results to refute a set of popular ill omens. The list of the 'Extinguishing and Submerging' is the same as the Yi Yin's Four Extinguishing and Four Submerging hexagrams (LY.ILL.YY.08), which the Yi Mao names together, and the two books match the seasons the same way. 'Heavenly emolument' here is Wealth. In 'the Jiazi decade leaves Hai Void' the Void of the Jiazi decade is Xu and Hai, so a Hai natal branch is left Void.

units.title: 土鬼独发而祷于疾病者九死一生：用有气则祷土以回生、用无援则开墓以葬死；东南土薄犯土忌禳土得生者十六七，西北土厚不畏土禁祈而无功

rule.yi: 常常试到：土鬼独自发动、又为疾病祈祷的，九死一生。有人说，用爻有气，祷告土神就能回生；用爻没有援助，就是开墓来葬死人，这话确实可信。注引《天元赋》说：土和煞一起发动，一定成为黄泉下的客；《补遗》说：夏天论，土爻带鬼发动，凶多吉少，祸难禳解。大体上东南土地薄，犯了土的忌讳、禳土而得生的，十个有六七个；西北土地厚，不怕土的禁忌，所以祈祷也没有功效。
rule.en: I have often tried it: where an Earth ghost moves alone and one prays over an illness, nine die and one lives. Some say that if the Subject line has force, praying to the earth spirit restores life, and if it has no help it is opening a tomb to bury the dead; this is truly credible. The note quotes the Tianyuan Fu: when Earth and killing stars both rise, he is sure to become a guest of the Yellow Springs; and the Buyi: in summer, an Earth line carrying a moving ghost is mostly ominous and seldom auspicious, and the misfortune is hard to exorcise. In general the earth of the southeast is thin, and of those who have offended earth taboos and exorcised the earth, six or seven in ten live; the earth of the northwest is thick and does not fear earth prohibitions, so prayer there has no effect.

zh: 常试土鬼独发，而祷于疾病者，九死一生，或曰用有气，则祷土以回生，用无援，则开墓以葬死，良可信也。
yi: 常常试到：土鬼独自发动、又为疾病祈祷的，九死一生；有人说，用爻有气，祷告土神就能回生；用爻没有援助，就是开墓来葬死人，这话确实可信。
en: I have often tried it: where an Earth ghost moves alone and one prays over an illness, nine die and one lives; some say that if the Subject line has force, praying to the earth spirit restores life, and if it has no help it is opening a tomb to bury the dead; this is truly credible.

zh: 天元赋曰：土煞俱兴，定作黄泉之客；
补遗云：夏论土爻临鬼动，多凶少吉祸难禳。
大抵东南土薄，有犯土忌，禳土得生者，十有六七，西北土厚，不畏土禁，所以祈而无功也。
yi: 《天元赋》说：土和煞一起发动，一定成为黄泉下的客；
《补遗》说：夏天论，土爻带鬼发动，凶多吉少，祸难禳解。
大体上东南土地薄，犯了土的忌讳、禳土而得生的，十个有六七个；西北土地厚，不怕土的禁忌，所以祈祷也没有功效。
en: The Tianyuan Fu says: when Earth and killing stars both rise, he is sure to become a guest of the Yellow Springs;
the Buyi says: in summer, an Earth line carrying a moving ghost is mostly ominous and seldom auspicious, and the misfortune is hard to exorcise.

In general the earth of the southeast is thin, and of those who have offended earth taboos and exorcised the earth, six or seven in ten live; the earth of the northwest is thick and does not fear earth prohibitions, so prayer there has no effect.

note.yi: 「天元赋」不知是哪部书，「补遗」按上下文是《易林补遗》，书里没有说明。「土禁」「土忌」是动土等犯土神的忌讳。这一条把「土鬼独发要祷」讲成地域的差别：东南土薄、犯土忌的多，禳土有效；西北土厚，祈祷无功。
note.en: The 'Tianyuan Fu' is not known as a work, and the 'Buyi' is by context the Yilin Buyi, which the book does not say. 'Earth prohibitions' and 'earth taboos' are the taboos of offending the earth spirit, by breaking ground and the like. This entry turns 'an Earth ghost moving alone calls for prayer' into a matter of region: in the thin-earthed southeast, where earth taboos are often broken, exorcising the earth works; in the thick-earthed northwest, prayer is without effect.

units.title: 游魂归魂保于旅而不保于家；震巽坤艮危于老而不危于少（震棺巽椁艮塚坤墓）；女终男穷（归妹未济）非壮年之问

rule.yi: 游魂、归魂的卦，在外做客时保得住，在家里却保不住；震、巽、坤、艮的卦，对老人危险，对年轻人不危险；女终、男穷（归妹、未济）不适合壮年人来问。注：游魂是去、归魂是回来，如果病在旅途中，路上就没有忌讳；震象棺，巽象椁，艮象坟冢，坤象坟墓，对上了年纪的人是大忌，有所准备反而更凶；未济、归妹，壮年人不适合；但也要兼用神参看。
rule.en: In Wandering Soul and Returning Soul hexagrams he is safe abroad but not at home; in Zhen, Xun, Kun and Gen he is in danger if old but not if young; 'the woman's end' and 'the man's exhaustion' (Guimei and Weiji) are not fitting for a divination by a man in his prime. The note: Wandering is going out and Returning is coming back, and if the illness falls on a journey the road holds no taboo; Zhen is the coffin, Xun the outer coffin, Gen the mound and Kun the grave, a great taboo for the old, and to be prepared is worse; Weiji and Guimei are not fitting for the prime of life; but one must also consult the Subject.

zh: 游魂归魂，保于旅而不保于家，震巽坤艮，危于老而不危于少，女终男穷，非宜壮年之问也。
yi: 游魂、归魂的卦，在外做客时保得住，在家里却保不住；震、巽、坤、艮的卦，对老人危险，对年轻人不危险；女终、男穷（归妹、未济），不适合壮年人来问。
en: In Wandering Soul and Returning Soul hexagrams he is safe abroad but not at home; in Zhen, Xun, Kun and Gen he is in danger if old but not if young; 'the woman's end' and 'the man's exhaustion' (Guimei and Weiji) are not fitting for a divination by a man in his prime.

zh: 游往归来，病于客旅，道途不忌；
震为棺，巽为椁，艮为塚，坤为墓，衰年大忌，有备更凶；
未济归妹，壮岁非宜。
然亦兼用神而参。
yi: 游魂是去、归魂是回来，如果病在旅途中，路上就没有忌讳；
震象棺，巽象椁，艮象坟冢，坤象坟墓，对上了年纪的人是大忌，有所准备反而更凶；
未济、归妹，壮年人不适合。
但也要兼用神来参看。
en: Wandering is going out and Returning is coming back, and if the illness falls on a journey, the road holds no taboo;
Zhen is the coffin, Xun the outer coffin, Gen the mound and Kun the grave; for the old it is a great taboo, and to be prepared is worse;
Weiji and Guimei are not fitting for the prime of life.
But one must also consult the Subject.

note.yi: 「女终男穷」按《序卦传》，归妹是女之终，未济是男之穷；书里没有再解释，注里用卦名点了出来。「有备更凶」是说预先准备后事反而更凶，书里没有解释。这一条和易隐「黄泉杀、棺椁杀」一类按卦名断死（LY.ILL.YY.08）相近，但易冒这里要「兼用神而参」，不单凭卦名。
note.en: 'The woman's end and the man's exhaustion' are, after the Xu Gua Zhuan, Guimei as the woman's end and Weiji as the man's exhaustion; the book does not explain further and the note names them by hexagram. 'To be prepared is worse' means that to prepare for the funeral in advance is worse, which the book does not explain. This entry is close to the Yi Yin's judging death by hexagram names, the 'Yellow Springs' and 'Coffin' killers (LY.ILL.YY.08), but here the Yi Mao says 'also consult the Subject' and does not rely on the hexagram name alone.

units.title: 二生、两病、生之道、死之途：忌神摇而元神动是二生；元神动而仇神摇是两病；忌仇动而元神暗摇是生之道；无忌动而用神明坏是死之途

rule.yi: 忌神发动了，而原神也动，叫做二生；原神动了，而仇神也动，叫做两病；忌神、仇神动了，原神暗中动，是生路；没有忌神动，而用神明明白白地坏了，是死路。注举例：未月丙申日，占母亲的病，得同人变噬嗑，申是忌神本来克卯，亥是原神，发动泄掉忌神的气而生卯木用爻，这是二生；卯月乙卯日，占妻子的病，得同人变咸，子孙发动生财，本来是原神帮我，但卯木仇神来克戌爻，又多一层病；未月壬寅日，占丈夫的病，得同人变既济，兄、子都动，伤官本应病重，但寅申冲财，暗发生亥，后来病好起来；卯月丙寅日，占儿子本人，得坤变损，卦里有父、兄发动，木来救子孙，但酉金明明受日绝、月破，所以救不了。
rule.en: The Adversary moves and the Support also moves: this is called the double life; the Support moves and the enemy spirit also moves: the double illness; the Adversary and enemy spirit move and the Support stirs in secret: a road to life; the Adversary does not move but the Subject is plainly spoiled: a road to death. The note's examples: in the Wei month on the Bingshen day, a mother's illness was divined and Tongren changing into Shihe obtained: Shen is the Adversary and by nature controls Mao, while Hai is the Support and moves to drain the Adversary's qi and generate the Mao Wood Subject line — the double life; in the Mao month on the Yimao day, a wife's illness was divined and Tongren changing into Xian obtained: Output moves to generate Wealth, which should have been the Support helping me, but Mao Wood, the enemy spirit, controls the Xu line, adding one more illness; in the Wei month on the Renyin day, a husband's illness was divined and Tongren changing into Jiji obtained: Peer and Output both move and harm Pressure, so it should be grave, but Yin clashes Shen Wealth and secretly stirs it to generate Hai, and later he recovered; in the Mao month on the Bingyin day, a son himself was divined and Kun changing into Sun obtained: Resource and Peer move, and Wood comes to rescue Output, but You Metal is plainly in Extinction by the Day and in Month-break, so it could not be saved.

zh: 忌神摇矣，元神动焉，谓之二生也；
元神动矣，仇神摇焉，谓之两病也；
忌仇动矣，元神暗摇，生之道也；
无忌动矣，用神明坏，死之途也。
yi: 忌神发动了，而原神也动，叫做二生；
原神动了，而仇神也动，叫做两病；
忌神、仇神动了，原神暗中动，是生路；
没有忌神动，而用神明明白白地坏了，是死路。
en: The Adversary moves and the Support also moves: this is called the double life;
the Support moves and the enemy spirit also moves: this is called the double illness;
the Adversary and enemy spirit move and the Support stirs in secret: this is a road to life;
the Adversary does not move but the Subject is plainly spoiled: this is a road to death.

zh: 如未建丙申日，占母病得同人之噬嗑，申乃忌神，本来克卯，亥乃元神，动泄忌神之气，而生卯木用爻，是为二生；
卯建乙卯日，占妻病得同人之咸，子动生财，本谓元神助我，卯木仇神相克戌爻，更多一病也；
如未建壬寅日，占夫病得同人之既济，兄子皆动，伤官应笃，寅申冲财，暗发生亥，后病得起；
如卯建丙寅日，占子身得坤之损，卦有父兄发动，木来救子，然酉金明受日绝月破，所以不能救也。
余仿此。
yi: 比如未月丙申日，占母亲的病，得到同人变噬嗑，申是忌神本来克卯，亥是原神，发动泄掉忌神的气，而生卯木用爻，这就是二生；
卯月乙卯日，占妻子的病，得到同人变咸，子孙发动生财，本来是原神帮我，但卯木仇神来克戌爻，又多了一层病；
未月壬寅日，占丈夫的病，得到同人变既济，兄、子都动，伤到官爻，病本应重，但寅申冲财，暗中发动生亥，后来病好起来了；
卯月丙寅日，占儿子本人，得到坤变损，卦里有父、兄发动，木来救子孙，但酉金明明受日绝、月破，所以救不了。
其余照此。
en: For example, in the Wei month on the Bingshen day, a mother's illness was divined and Tongren changing into Shihe obtained: Shen is the Adversary and by nature controls Mao, while Hai is the Support and moves to drain the Adversary's qi and generate the Mao Wood Subject line — this is the double life;

in the Mao month on the Yimao day, a wife's illness was divined and Tongren changing into Xian obtained: Output moves to generate Wealth, which should have been the Support helping me, but Mao Wood, the enemy spirit, controls the Xu line, adding one more illness;

in the Wei month on the Renyin day, a husband's illness was divined and Tongren changing into Jiji obtained: Peer and Output both move and harm Pressure, so it should be grave, but Yin clashes Shen Wealth and secretly stirs it to generate Hai, and later he recovered;

in the Mao month on the Bingyin day, a son himself was divined and Kun changing into Sun obtained: Resource and Peer move, and Wood comes to rescue Output, but You Metal is plainly in Extinction by the Day and in Month-break, so it could not be saved.
The rest follow this.

note.yi: 「二生」是有两条生路（忌神被原神泄去、又生用神），「两病」是原神之外又有仇神一起动、多一层病；「仇神」是生忌神的爻。这一组和卜筮正宗讲原神忌神仇神的《原忌仇神论》（第 967 行起）是同一套用法。第三例里「伤官应笃」的「官」是丈夫的用神（占夫以官为用）。
note.en: The 'double life' is two roads to life (the Adversary drained by the Support, which also generates the Subject), and the 'double illness' is the enemy spirit moving together with the Support so that there is one more illness; the 'enemy spirit' (chou shen) is the line that generates the Adversary. This group is the same usage as the Bushi Zhengzong's essay on the Support, Adversary and enemy spirit (from line 967). In the third example the 'Pressure' of 'harming Pressure it should be grave' is the husband's Subject (Pressure is the Subject in divining for a husband).

units.title: 非危之象：飞爻用神绝而伏爻用神生、内卦用神亡而外卦用神存、卦爻无用神而日月有用神，皆非危

rule.yi: 飞爻上的用神绝了，但伏爻上的用神生旺，不危险；内卦的用神没了，但外卦的用神还在，不危险；卦爻里没有用神，但日、月里有用神，不危险。注举例：寅月丙寅日，占兄弟，得乾变需，申飞在用爻上，日破月破，却不知道酉伏在戌下，火生土而土生金，所以说不危险；辰月辛卯日，占儿子本人，得未济，外卦的未虽旬空，内卦的辰当月建，后来病好了；午月戊寅日，占妻子本人，得既济，卦里虽然没有用爻，但月是午、日是寅，原神和用神都出现，当月病就好了。
rule.en: If the Subject on the flying line is in Extinction but the Subject on the hidden line is born, there is no danger; if the Subject in the inner trigram is lost but the Subject in the outer trigram remains, there is no danger; if there is no Subject among the lines of the hexagram but the Day or Month holds the Subject, there is no danger. The note's examples: in the Yin month on the Bingyin day, a brother was divined and Qian changing into Xu obtained: Shen stood on the Subject line as the flying line, in Day-break and Month-break, but it was not noticed that You lay hidden beneath Xu, and Fire generates Earth and Earth generates Metal, so it is said there is no danger; in the Chen month on the Xinmao day, a son himself was divined and Weiji obtained: Wei in the outer trigram was in Void, but Chen in the inner trigram stood on the Month, and later he recovered; in the Wu month on the Wuyin day, a wife herself was divined and Jiji obtained: though there was no Subject line in the hexagram, the month was Wu and the day Yin, and the Support and the Subject both appeared, and that month she recovered.

zh: 飞爻之用神绝，伏爻之用神生，非危也；
内卦之用神亡，外卦之用神存，非危也；
卦爻之用神无，日月之用神有，非危也。
yi: 飞爻上的用神绝了，伏爻上的用神生旺，不危险；
内卦的用神没了，外卦的用神还在，不危险；
卦爻里没有用神，日、月里有用神，不危险。
en: If the Subject on the flying line is in Extinction but the Subject on the hidden line is born, there is no danger;
if the Subject in the inner trigram is lost but the Subject in the outer trigram remains, there is no danger;
if there is no Subject among the lines of the hexagram but the Day or Month holds the Subject, there is no danger.

zh: 如寅建丙寅日，占弟兄得乾之需，申飞用爻，日破月破，而不知酉伏戌下，火生土而土生金，故曰非危也；
如辰建辛卯日，占子身得未济，外未虽旬空，内辰当月建，后愈；
如午建戊寅日，占妻身得既济，卦内虽无用爻，月午日寅，元用并现，当月病愈。
yi: 比如寅月丙寅日，占兄弟，得乾变需，申飞在用爻上，日破月破，却不知道酉伏在戌下，火生土而土生金，所以说不危险；
如辰月辛卯日，占儿子本人，得未济，外卦的未虽旬空，内卦的辰当月建，后来病好了；
如午月戊寅日，占妻子本人，得既济，卦里虽然没有用爻，但月是午、日是寅，原神和用神都出现，当月病就好了。
en: For example, in the Yin month on the Bingyin day, a brother was divined and Qian changing into Xu obtained: Shen stood on the Subject line as the flying line, in Day-break and Month-break, but it was not noticed that You lay hidden beneath Xu, and Fire generates Earth and Earth generates Metal, so it is said there is no danger;
in the Chen month on the Xinmao day, a son himself was divined and Weiji obtained: Wei in the outer trigram was in Void, but Chen in the inner trigram stood on the Month, and later he recovered;

in the Wu month on the Wuyin day, a wife herself was divined and Jiji obtained: though there was no Subject line in the hexagram, the month was Wu and the day Yin, and the Support and the Subject both appeared, and that month she recovered.

note.yi: 「飞爻」是卦里现出来的那一爻，「伏爻」是伏在它下面的爻。第一个例子里申金飞在用爻上而日破月破，看起来危险，但酉金伏在戌土下面，火生土、土生金，伏着的用神得生，所以不危。「外未」「内辰」是外卦的未、内卦的辰。
note.en: The 'flying line' is the line that appears in the hexagram and the 'hidden line' the one hidden beneath it. In the first example Shen Metal stands on the Subject line as the flying line and is in Day-break and Month-break, which looks dangerous, but You Metal is hidden beneath Xu Earth, Fire generates Earth and Earth generates Metal, so the hidden Subject is born and there is no danger. 'The Wei of the outer' and 'the Chen of the inner' are the Wei in the outer trigram and the Chen in the inner.

units.title: 用神有一生则生、有一死则死：日月动爻克用而用得化生扶则非危；日月动爻不生不克而用神化克则危；变爻亦宜无病乃真有救

rule.yi: 日、月、动爻克用爻，这叫做不得救，但用爻变出生它、扶它的，不危险；日、月、动爻对用神不生也不克，而用神变出克它的，就危险了。所以说：用神有一个生它的就活，有一个死的就死。注：这是说用神变生、变克是最要紧的办法，但变出的爻也应当没有毛病，才是真有救。比如未月甲辰日，占儿子本人，得咸变蹇，日、月克用爻，大凶，但用爻变出兄弟长生，所以不死；戌月戊申日，占父亲本人，得艮变蛊，用爻独自发动本该活，因为变出去在亥绝，就救不了了。
rule.en: If the Day, Month and moving lines control the Subject line, this is called no rescue, but if the Subject line changes into what generates or supports it, there is no danger; if the Day, Month and moving lines neither generate nor control the Subject, but the Subject changes into what controls it, it is in danger. So it is said: if the Subject has one source of life it lives, and if it has one death it dies. The note: this says that the Subject changing into generation or control is the most important method, but the changed line must also be without flaw for the rescue to be real: for example, in the Wei month on the Jiachen day, a son himself was divined and Xian changing into Jian (Obstruction) obtained; the Day and Month control the Subject line, a great ill omen, but the Subject changed into Peer at Birth, so he did not die; in the Xu month on the Wushen day, a father himself was divined and Gen changing into Gu obtained: the Subject line moved alone and should have lived, but it changed into Extinction at Hai and so could not be saved.

zh: 犹有日月动爻克用，是谓不救，而用爻得化生扶，非危也。
日月动爻，与用神不生不克，而用神化克则危矣。
故曰用神有一生则生，有一死则死。
yi: 还有日、月、动爻克用爻，这叫做不得救，但用爻变出生它、扶它的，不危险。
日、月、动爻对用神不生也不克，而用神变出克它的，就危险了。
所以说：用神有一个生它的就活，有一个死的就死。
en: Again, if the Day, Month and moving lines control the Subject line, this is called no rescue, but if the Subject line changes into what generates or supports it, there is no danger.
If the Day, Month and moving lines neither generate nor control the Subject, but the Subject changes into what controls it, it is in danger.
So it is said: if the Subject has one source of life it lives, and if it has one death it dies.

zh: 此言用神化生化克为最要法，然变爻亦宜无病，乃真有救，如未建甲辰日，占子身得咸之蹇，日月克用大凶，而用化兄弟长生，是乃不死；
戌建戊申日，占父身得艮之蛊，用爻独发当生，以化绝于亥遂不救。
yi: 这是说用神变生、变克是最要紧的办法，但变出的爻也应当没有毛病，才是真有救；比如未月甲辰日，占儿子本人，得咸变蹇，日、月克用爻，大凶，但用爻变出兄弟长生，所以不死；
戌月戊申日，占父亲本人，得艮变蛊，用爻独自发动本该活，因为变出去在亥绝，就救不了了。
en: This says that the Subject changing into generation or control is the most important method, but the changed line must also be without flaw for the rescue to be real: for example, in the Wei month on the Jiachen day, a son himself was divined and Xian changing into Jian (Obstruction) obtained; the Day and Month control the Subject line, a great ill omen, but the Subject changed into Peer at Birth, so he did not die;

in the Xu month on the Wushen day, a father himself was divined and Gen changing into Gu obtained: the Subject line moved alone and should have lived, but it changed into Extinction at Hai and so could not be saved.

note.yi: 这一条的核心是「用神有一生则生，有一死则死」：用神（所占那个人的爻）只要有一条生路就能活，只要有一条死路就死；注加了一层，变出去的爻自己也要没毛病。黄金策讲的「用绝逢生」「主衰得助」（LY.ILL.HJC.47、LY.ILL.HJC.48）与此相通。
note.en: The heart of this entry is 'the Subject with one source of life lives, with one death dies': as long as the Subject (the line of the person divined) has a road to life it lives, and a road to death it dies; the note adds that the line it changes into must itself be without flaw. The Huangjin Ce's 'Extinction meeting generation' and 'weak and yet helped' (LY.ILL.HJC.47 and LY.ILL.HJC.48) go with it.

units.title: 卦无用神：元神动则不死（趋生）；忌神动而用神伏反吉（避克）；亦必得日月之救

rule.yi: 卦里没有用神，说是凶兆，但得到原神发动就不会死，因为它是在趋向生路；忌神发动而用神伏藏，反而吉，因为它避开了克；虽然如此，也必须得到日、月的救助。注举例：酉月戊申日，占妻子本人，得睽变损，卦里没有用爻，本来不是吉兆，喜的是子孙发动，到冬天病好了，这叫趋生；亥月甲申日，也是占妻子本人，得姤变升，忌神发动，本来是凶兆，喜的是用神不出现，伏在月建下面，后来到子月壬辰日，病势逐渐缓解，因为申子辰会成水局，忌神合成了原神，这叫避克。
rule.en: A hexagram without the Subject is said to be an ill omen, but if the Support moves he does not die, because he is heading toward life; if the Adversary moves and the Subject is hidden it is instead auspicious, because it avoids the control; even so, it must also gain the rescue of the Day and Month. The note's examples: in the You month on the Wushen day, a wife herself was divined and Kui changing into Sun obtained: the hexagram had no Subject line and so was not auspicious, but happily Output moved, and by winter she recovered — this is 'heading toward life'; in the Hai month on the Jiashen day, again a wife herself was divined and Gou changing into Sheng obtained: the Adversary moved, which was an ill omen, but happily the Subject did not appear and was hidden beneath the Month, and later on the Renchen day of the Zi month the illness gradually eased, for Shen, Zi and Chen meet to form a Water frame and the Adversary is combined into the Support — this is 'avoiding control'.

zh: 卦无用神，云谓凶兆，然得元神动则不死，以其趋生也。
忌神动而用神伏反吉，以其避克也，虽然，亦必得日月之救焉。
yi: 卦里没有用神，说是凶兆，但得到原神发动就不会死，因为它是在趋向生路。
忌神发动而用神伏藏反而吉，因为它避开了克；虽然如此，也必须得到日、月的救助。
en: A hexagram without the Subject is said to be an ill omen, but if the Support moves he does not die, because he is heading toward life.
If the Adversary moves and the Subject is hidden it is instead auspicious, because it avoids the control; even so, it must also gain the rescue of the Day and Month.

zh: 如酉建戊申日，占妻身得睽之损，卦无用爻，本非吉兆，喜得子孙发动，及冬病愈，是谓趋生也；
如亥建甲申日，亦占妻身，得姤之升，忌神发动，本是凶兆，喜用神不现，伏于月建之下，后交子月壬辰日，病势渐解。
盖申子辰会水局，忌神合为元神，是谓避克也。
yi: 如酉月戊申日，占妻子本人，得睽变损，卦里没有用爻，本来不是吉兆，喜的是子孙发动，到冬天病好了，这叫趋生；
如亥月甲申日，也是占妻子本人，得姤变升，忌神发动，本来是凶兆，喜的是用神不出现，伏在月建下面，后来到子月壬辰日，病势逐渐缓解。
因为申、子、辰会成水局，忌神合成了原神，这叫避克。
en: In the You month on the Wushen day, a wife herself was divined and Kui changing into Sun obtained: the hexagram had no Subject line and so was not auspicious, but happily Output moved, and by winter she recovered — this is 'heading toward life';

in the Hai month on the Jiashen day, again a wife herself was divined and Gou changing into Sheng obtained: the Adversary moved, which was an ill omen, but happily the Subject did not appear and was hidden beneath the Month, and later on the Renchen day of the Zi month the illness gradually eased.
For Shen, Zi and Chen meet to form a Water frame, the Adversary is combined into the Support, and this is 'avoiding control'.

note.yi: 「趋生」是用神不在，但原神发动，气往生的方向走；「避克」是忌神发动，用神却伏藏起来，躲开了被克。第二例里申子辰三合水局，把本来的忌神（水，克火用神？）合成了原神，所以化险。这两条和卜筮正宗《原忌仇神论》里的「避空、避凶」（第 970 行）是同一套讲法。
note.en: 'Heading toward life' is when the Subject is absent but the Support moves and the qi goes toward life; 'avoiding control' is when the Adversary moves and the Subject lies hidden and escapes being controlled. In the second example Shen, Zi and Chen form a Water frame in three-harmony, combining what had been the Adversary into the Support, and so the danger is turned. These two are the same manner of speaking as the 'avoiding Void' and 'avoiding ill' in the Bushi Zhengzong's essay on the Support, Adversary and enemy spirit (line 970).
